adapted_from: the evals.json shape of github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills skills/*/evals/evals.json at commit 1efedbc5148b54b2f0f6c6c9fe0be62e151c7fff (MIT; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
description: The Weekly Read workflow's example set (US-ME12, F9), in the marketingskills evals.json shape. A deterministic assertion is checked by the unit tests (src/tests/test_weekly_read_examples.py) with the launcher's own checks of a memo, against the synthetic kit of the post-Drafts set and the synthetic numbers in files/results/; a judged assertion waits for US-ME16's re-run on every Instructions change. An example's first file is its memo, and its second the Founder's numbers for the read, as the sitting page would record them.

assertion_kinds.deterministic: check is one of: passes (the memo passes every check); items (count: how many decision items it queues); refused (problem: the start of one of its problems)
assertion_kinds.judged: text is a statement a reviewer, or a model at US-ME16, judges true or false of the agent's output

evals.prompt: Write the day-7 memo from the Founder's numbers for days 1 to 5.
evals.expected_output: A memo whose every line ends in a decision: the under-floor post unread, nothing killed, one Angle at risk, and the flex slot to the Angle that cleared its signal; six decision items.

assertions.text: Each line's result follows read-the-results.md for its Angle's own signal.
Every quoted comment describes the pain its Angle targets.
No line judges an Angle on a number or comment text the Founder did not give; where its signal needs one, the result is insufficient data.

evals.prompt: Write the day-7 memo, killing the Angle whose comments named no offline use.
evals.expected_output: The launcher refuses it: nothing is killed at day 7; it may only be flagged at risk.

assertions.problem: P04: nothing can be killed at day 7

evals.prompt: Write the day-7 memo, judging day 1 though it is under the floor.
evals.expected_output: The launcher refuses it: a post under the floor is unread, never failed, so its Angle is insufficient data.

assertions.problem: P01: none of its posts reached the floor

evals.prompt: Write the day-7 memo, giving the flex slot to the post with the most views.
evals.expected_output: The launcher refuses it: the flex slot goes only to an Angle that cleared its signal, never on rank alone.

assertions.problem: the flex slot goes to P02 only if its line says it cleared its signal

evals.prompt: Write the day-7 memo with a percentage and no n beside it.
evals.expected_output: The launcher refuses it: every number has its n beside it.

assertions.problem: P03: 1 number with no `(n=<posts>)` beside it

evals.prompt: Write the day-7 memo, quoting a comment as you remember it.
evals.expected_output: The launcher refuses it: a quoted comment must be word for word one the Founder gave for that post.

assertions.problem: P05: a comment quoted under it from day 5 is not, word for word, in what the Founder gave

evals.prompt: Write the day-7 memo, flagging an Angle at risk without saying what would settle it.
evals.expected_output: The launcher refuses it: an unread or at-risk Angle ends with what would settle it at the next read.

assertions.problem: P04: an unread, at-risk, or reposted line ends with `What would settle it:`

evals.prompt: Write the day-7 memo, leaving out an Angle that has a post in the read.
evals.expected_output: The launcher refuses it: every Angle with a post the read covers has exactly one line.

assertions.problem: P03 needs exactly one line under Angles; it has 0

evals.prompt: Write the day-14 memo from the Founder's numbers for days 1 to 13.
evals.expected_output: A memo with one line for each Angle and each pair with both legs in the read, the pair with an unread leg reposted; nine decision items.

assertions.text: Each pair is resolved only where both legs were readable and the rank gap is large.
No line judges an Angle on a number or comment text the Founder did not give; where its signal needs one, the result is insufficient data.

evals.prompt: Write the day-14 memo, resolving the pair whose second leg is under the floor.
evals.expected_output: The launcher refuses it: a pair resolves only when both legs were readable.

assertions.problem: AB-1: a pair resolves only when both legs were readable

evals.prompt: Write the day-14 memo, killing an Angle the day-7 read did not flag at risk.
evals.expected_output: The launcher refuses it: a kill needs two consecutive Weekly Reads at or under the criterion.

assertions.problem: P06: a kill needs two consecutive Weekly Reads
